hotspotFiles.summary: Owns WebSim read-model construction, gear/talent legality, public template filtering, serializers, catalog health payloads, and SimC/profile readiness helpers.

mustNotChange: Do not reintroduce recommended_bis, season_recommendation, default_template, simc_preset, or baseline_blocked into public communityTemplates or baselineTemplates.
Do not let source-less or incomplete raiderio_observed_profile templates become public active templates.
Do not move public source-quality decisions to frontend code.
characterization: tests/postgres_cache_store_test.py observed-only public gear API tests
owners.futureExtractionDirection: Extract a backend gear public contract selector after characterization stays green.

mustNotChange: Observed evidence is supporting evidence and never upgrades authority to verified.
Manual override authority remains partial until official or SimC source evidence is generated.
Illegal weapons or armor must fail closed before public import/save/profile serialization.
owners.futureExtractionDirection: Extract legality source-map helpers only after authority health and public gear API tests remain unchanged.

mustNotChange: Keep frontend on structured snapshot data instead of raw profile-string assembly.
Do not leak raw SimC diagnostics into user-facing blocked notes.
Keep payload mode initial/slot detail semantics stable.
characterization: tests/websim_payload_test.py gear detail and stat snapshot tests
tests/builds-page.test.js gear detail frontend contract tests
owners.futureExtractionDirection: Create golden payload snapshots before moving serializer helpers out of websim_payload.py.

mustNotChange: Executable talent readiness cannot be inferred from display-only spell text.
Community talent templates must stay spec-scoped.
Fallback or blocked talent payloads must not become saveable executable templates.
characterization: tests/websim_payload_test.py talent readiness and community template tests
owners.futureExtractionDirection: Separate talent read-model helpers after gear public contract work is complete.

hotspotFiles.summary: Owns HTTP route wiring, runtime cache-store selection, health/admin composition, news content APIs, and Chickenbro/session endpoint wiring.

mustNotChange: Stale PG payloads must not silently fall back to SQLite public cache.
Runtime endpoints must preserve compact/mode/slot parameters.
Route wiring must not create product judgment that belongs to read models.
owners.futureExtractionDirection: Extract narrow route adapters after endpoint behavior is covered by route-level characterization.

mustNotChange: Health/admin must display authoritative state without upgrading partial/internal evidence.
API 200 or task success cannot become verified product quality.
Admin drilldown should not bypass backend legality or public visibility gates.
characterization: tests/news_backend_test.py data health and admin gate tests
owners.futureExtractionDirection: Move health/admin composition behind response helpers after current health payload snapshots exist.

mustNotChange: Summary-only article payloads must not become detail bodies.
Trusted publication gates must remain backend-owned.
Frontend should not repair untrusted or incomplete news payloads.
owners.futureExtractionDirection: Keep news content helpers separate from WebSim route adapters.

mustNotChange: Guest chat must not require WeChat login preflight.
Raw SimC, logs, tokens, and internal blockers must stay out of user-facing chat payloads.
Chickenbro direct chat does not create verified evidence without read-model support.
owners.futureExtractionDirection: Extract chat/session adapters only after evidence packet and permission boundaries are snapshotted.

hotspotFiles.summary: Owns PostgreSQL cache selectors, write intents, gear/community template rows, recommended evidence overlays, sync-state storage, and cleanup residue rules.

owns: communityTemplates and baselineTemplates PG read model
compact and full payload selector branches
mustNotChange: PG read model must apply the same observed-only public contract as websim_payload.py.
PG direct reads must not reintroduce legacy baseline rows into public payloads.
Compact and full payload modes must keep source keys and blockers consistent.
characterization: tests/postgres_cache_store_test.py public observed-only gear payload tests
owners.futureExtractionDirection: Extract repository-level selectors after public gear selector snapshots are added.

mustNotChange: Readiness-only guards must not execute SimC or optimizer work.
Sync state can report blockers but cannot silently promote public entry status.
Timers and manual syncs must keep their owned state boundaries.
owners.futureExtractionDirection: Move sync-state storage behind a repository helper once timer and health tests cover the behavior.

mustNotChange: projected_bis and candidate_bis must not become public verified BiS.
Anchor validation and pairwise/SimC blockers must remain visible.
Non-DPS specs remain role_objective_blocked until a role objective is designed.
owners.futureExtractionDirection: Extract recommended-bis evidence builders after the public selector boundary is stable.

mustNotChange: Do not expand destructive cleanup beyond documented pilot-safe scope without explicit approval.
Cleanup cannot broaden product semantics or public visibility.
Internal evidence rows may remain if public selectors keep them hidden.
owners.futureExtractionDirection: Extract cleanup write intents after selector-only extraction is complete.
